Serious Performance , With its responsive throttle and aggressive power delivery, the M3 feels dramatically different from a standard 3 Series. Incredible Handling , A sophisticated suspension, rear-wheel drive, near-perfect weight distribution, and M-specific tuning give it excellent balance through corners. Available 6-Speed Manual , For enthusiasts, the manual transmission makes the M3 especially engaging and gives you much more involvement behind the wheel. Available 7-Speed DCT , The dual-clutch transmission provides extremely quick shifts and lets the car feel remarkably fast when driven hard. That V8 Sound , The high-rpm exhaust note is one of the M3's defining characteristics. It's a very different experience from the turbocharged engines that came later. Aggressive M Styling , Wider fenders, M-specific bumpers, quad exhaust outlets, and a muscular stance make it immediately recognizable. True M Performance DNA , It's engineered with lessons from BMW's motorsport program, giving it a much more focused character than an ordinary 3 Series. Still Practical , Unlike many dedicated sports cars, the M3 gives you a usable cabin, four seats, and a trunk, making it possible to enjoy it as a daily driver. Modern Classic Potential , The E92-generation M3 is particularly desirable because it's the last M3 generation to use a naturally aspirated V8. THE BIG SELLING POINT The 2013 M3 isn't just fast,it's an experience. description: The 2012 Mercedes-Benz E-Class E 350 4MATIC Wagon 4D stands as a highly desirable, exceptionally versatile benchmark in the luxury station wagon segment, representing a key technology update year for the fourth-generation (S212) platform. Built on a rigid unibody chassis architecture with acoustic windshield insulation, this four-door long-roof wagon pairs executive-class highway comfort and whisper-quiet cabin serenity with unique 7-passenger capability, all-weather stability, and expansive cargo space.Under the sculpted aluminum hood sits Mercedes-Benz's upgraded, naturally aspirated 3.5-liter Direct-Injection DOHC 24-valve V6 engine (M276). This mechanical core generates 302 horsepower at 6,500 RPM and 273 lb-ft of torque available from 3,500 to 5,200 RPM. Power is managed by a rapid-shifting 7-speed 7G-TRONIC PLUS automatic transmission with steering-wheel shift paddles. Drive torque is routed continuously to all four wheels via Mercedes-Benz's 4MATIC permanent all-wheel-drive system. Supported by a rear self-leveling AIRMATIC air suspension, 4-wheel independent multi-link geometry, and 4-wheel ventilated disc brakes with ABS, the 4,213-lb E 350 Wagon accelerates from 0 to 60 MPH in 6.9 seconds (or under 6.0 seconds in independent testing) on its way to an electronically limited top speed of 130 MPH.Edmunds+ 1On the exterior, the 2012 E 350 Wagon executes a stately, functional visual statement defined by a traditional three-bar chrome front grille with a stand-up hood ornament (or twin-blade star grille on Sport packages), lower LED daytime running lights, dual-trapezoidal chrome exhaust tailpipes, and integrated aluminum roof rails. Functional exterior features include power-folding heated side mirrors with integrated turn signals, dynamic rain-sensing windshield wipers, a power glass sunroof, a rear window wiper with washer, a power liftgate, and an assertive stance rolling on 17-inch 5-spoke alloy wheels wrapped in all-season touring tires (with 18-inch AMG 5-spoke wheels widely optioned).2012 Mercedes E-Class | Specifications - Car Specs | Auto123Inside, the driver-centric cockpit welcomes up to seven occupants into a tailored luxury sanctuary, featuring a standard rear-facing 3rd-row bench seat that folds completely flat into the cargo floor when not in use. The cabin is draped in MB-Tex synthetic leather upholstery (or optional genuine Nappa leather) paired with real Burl Walnut or Black Ash wood interior trim inlays. The layout features 10-way power-adjustable heated front seats with 3-position driver memory, a leather-wrapped multifunction sport steering wheel, Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control, proximity keyless entry with push-button start, auto-dimming interior lighting, and 60/40 split-folding second-row seats. Digital connectivity centers around the COMAND infotainment system featuring a central 7.0-inch color display screenwith a console-mounted rotary controller, 3D Navigation, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, SiriusXM satellite radio, dynamic vehicle telemetry, and a standard 8-speaker audio system (or available 14-speaker 610-watt Harman/Kardon LOGIC7 Surround Sound System).Practicality and interior spatial allocation serve as the primary competitive advantage of the S212 wagon platform thanks to its 113.2-inch wheelbase. Opening the power liftgate reveals 20.5 cubic feet of cargo space behind the second row (with the 3rd-row seat folded). Utilizing the quick-release levers to collapse both the second and third rows completely flat unlocks an immense 57.4 cubic feet of total flat cargo volume (and up to 68.9 cubic feet when loaded to the roofline), rivaling many midsize luxury SUVs.Kelley Blue BookBacked by a generous 21.1-gallon fuel tank, the 3.5L V6 4MATIC Wagon achieves an EPA-estimated 19 MPG city and 27 MPG highway (22 MPG combined). Safety is world-class, utilizing an ultra-high-strength steel passenger safety cage structure. The vehicle comes factory-equipped with ATTENTION ASSIST driver drowsiness monitor, PRE-SAFE predictive occupant protection system, Electronic Stability Program (ESP), 4-wheel Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), dynamic Rearview Camera, tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), available Driver Assistance Package (DISTRONIC PLUS Adaptive Cruise Control, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist), and a multi-stage 11-airbag protection canopy networkincluding dual front airbags, front side airbags, pelvic airbags, a driver's knee airbag, and full curtain airbags spanning all three rowsto guarantee total driving confidence across all weather conditions.[!@@Additional Info@@!]Moon Roof,Electronic Stability Control,Dual Air Bags,Heated Seats,Tilt & Telescoping Wheel,Keyless Entry,Power Door Locks,Leather,Daytime Running Lights,Knee Air Bags,Traction Control,Backup Camera,harman/kardon Sound,Alarm System,F&R Side Air Bags,CD/MP3 (Multi Disc),Alloy Wheels,Air Conditioning,Cruise Control,Power Steering,Dual Power Seats,Auto 7-Spd Sport Mode,Bluetooth Wireless,mbrace,ABS (4-Wheel),AWD,Third Row Seat,Power Windows,AM/FM Stereo,Navigation System,Luxury Pkg,F&R Head Curtain Air Bags,Fog Lights,V6 3.5 Liter

You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car.
